title: Check: Effect of Surface Area on Rate (2) (B)

questions.stem: In an experiment with marble chips and acid, powder, small chips, and large chips all produce the same total volume of gas. What does this confirm?

options.text: That surface area does not affect the reaction
That all three forms react at the same rate
That surface area affects the rate but not the total amount of product formed
That the experiment was not carried out correctly

questions.explanation: Since the same mass of calcium carbonate was used in all three experiments, the same total amount of CO₂ is produced regardless of surface area. Surface area only affects how quickly the product forms (the rate), not the total amount. The powder finishes fastest but produces the same total volume as the large chips.
